text:
[RLOW.5.6.5.2] Lowering `latest` adds a NOT sub-node **after the
sequence's last join**, where the anchor `d`, the first follower `m` and every
later follower are on the token ([IRET.7.10.2]). Its join test asserts no
candidate anchor that excludes the anchor with these followers
([LTHE.2.5.3]): the NOT sub-node blocks the match whenever a fact `f` of the
anchor's schema has `d.ts < f.ts < m.ts`, `m.ts − f.ts < T`, and none of the
anchor's `where` and the followers' `where`s, with `f` in the anchor's place,
answers `false` ([LNUL.4.7]).
Only the first follower's window involves the anchor ([LTHE.2.3.1]). In a
two-pattern sequence the last join is the first follower's.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__chain_newer_anchor_excludes
idris.note: `d.ts < f.ts < m.ts` and the window, on a three-step chain: the candidate at 2 between the anchor at 1 and the first follower at 3 blocks the match. Executed.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__excludes
idris.note: The NOT sub-node's join test on `ts`: `d.ts < f.ts < m.ts` and `m.ts - f.ts < T`, the token holding the anchor and the first follower. LESS than the clause: the anchor's `where` and every follower's `where` with `f` in the anchor's place are the fixture lowering's conjuncts, in the same test; the model's fact carries `ts` alone.

idris.name: lthe_2_5_3__latest_rules
idris.note: The NOT sub-node after the sequence's last join, on the anchor's alpha, under the exclusion. A fixture.

idris.name: rlow_5_6_5_2__minus_antitone
idris.note: Subtracting more leaves less: `d <= f` gives `m - f <= m - d`.

idris.name: rlow_5_6_5_2__window_implied
idris.note: The clause's `m.ts - f.ts < T` follows from its `d.ts < f.ts` and the match the sub-node guards, `m.ts - d.ts < T`: a conjunct a lowering may carry or leave.
